title: Detection of Metastatic Tumor Cells in the Bone Marrow Aspirate Smears by Artificial Intelligence (AI)-Based Morphogo System.
summary: In 60 patients, Morphogo AUC was 0.865; sensitivity/specificity varied by threshold and human pathologists remained more sensitive at the high-specificity threshold. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.

evidence.tested: In 60 patients, Morphogo AUC was 0.865; sensitivity/specificity varied by threshold and human pathologists remained more sensitive at the high-specificity threshold.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed study does not establish validation or benefit beyond its reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Morphogo deep-learning image analysis identified metastatic carcinoma clusters in bone-marrow aspirate smears.
